CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS message_relations (
                    relation_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                    store_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                    related_store_id INTEGER,
                    ordinal INTEGER,
                    observed_at REAL,
                    created_at REAL
                )
